title: Re-pin quest source build in release.yml release-gate probe for the 0.15.0 cut (ODOC-556)
description: The 0.15.0 rehearsal (release.yml run 41314948217, publish=false, on main eb13ece3) failed all six release-gate probe legs at setup-quest: notarget @opum-ai/quest@0.15.0, no staged rc, no source-ref. The probe needs quest declared version installable at dispatch time. Option 1 (quest stages its rc first) is circular: quest staging needs the opum-cli-e2e quest receipt, whose pair lock needs a lore 0.15.0 binary from a lore release run, and that run fails at the probe. 0.14.1 broke the same cycle with a QUEST_SOURCE_REF pin in release.yml (LCLI-714, 222ecb1b removed it under LCLI-750). Operator-approved cut, leader decision 2026-11-01 (option 2): reinstate that release.yml pin only, at quest-cli main f86d343cde21ca36641b554f65bfcb2add761e41 (package.json 0.15.0, verified against the remote). ci.yml stays as landed in lore-cli#702 (81645e55). Removal is LCLI-781, which already names release.yml. Release-path change (DEC-182 (1)): independent review before landing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: release.yml defines QUEST_SOURCE_REF as a full 40-hex commit that carries quest package.json version 0.15.0 and passes it as source-ref at its setup-quest call site

A test is red when the release.yml pin is absent and green when present, and the release.yml no-pin assertions in test/release-workflow.test.ts and test/ci-workflow.test.ts are replaced accordingly, with ci.yml unchanged

A release.yml dispatch with publish=false and launcher_rc=1 on this PR head (measured: run 41315886296 on ee894224): the four non-Windows release gate probe legs get past setup-quest and show latest 0.14.1 exiting 6 with the whole line out-of-date .codex/skills/lore/SKILL.md, and both Windows legs fail with exactly the DEC-204 (a4) setup-quest Windows refusal, so that evaluateWindowsProbeExcuse returns excused true against the run (Windows legs fail inside setup-quest by design on the source path, so a criterion that every leg gets past it cannot hold)
An independent reviewer unit passes this change at its final head before it merges
LCLI-781 is amended to say the release.yml pin is the one reinstated here and is removed with the ci.yml pin once quest 0.15.0 is on npm latest

implementationNotes: OPEN AMENDMENT 2026-11-01 (independent review of lore-cli#712 at ee894224, finding 2): AC 3 (position) said every release gate probe leg gets past setup-quest. That premise cannot hold: setup-quest refuses Windows on the source path by design, so win32-x64 and win32-arm64 fail inside it. Measured on run 41315886296: four non-Windows legs success with the 0.14.1 exit-6 line, both Windows legs fail with exactly the Windows refusal, and promote-latest.mjs evaluateWindowsProbeExcuse called with the real readers (1 jobs read, 2 logs, 1 quest publish-times read) returns excused true with both Windows arms named and no failures. Reject half, same call on the earlier all-red run 41314948217: excused false (condition 1/4, non-Windows legs failed). Rewording is the measurement only; nothing else in the criteria changed.

AC 4 ticked on the independent Opus review: round 1 at ee894224 REQUEST_CHANGES (ADR-0023 amendment false, AC premise impossible), round 2 at ada4d738 APPROVE (unit lore-cli-review-712b, claude-opus-5-5). Landed in lore-cli#712, squash 6cb4dbb07b727fd6b60df8612617bb40b244a8c2; PR CI on ada4d738 all required contexts success (run 41317394851).
finalSummary: Reinstated the release.yml QUEST_SOURCE_REF pin (quest-cli main f86d343c, package.json 0.15.0) for the 0.15.0 cut because the release-gate probe needs quest installable at dispatch time and quest cannot stage first. Landed in lore-cli#712 (squash 6cb4dbb0) after two independent review rounds. Rehearsal run 41315886296: four non-Windows probe legs pass with the 0.14.1 exit-6 line, both Windows legs fail only at the setup-quest Windows refusal, and evaluateWindowsProbeExcuse returns excused true. Removal is LCLI-781.
